verdict.rationale: SmartScan is documented to read merchant, date, total and currency from receipts in realtime, and Ask Expensify AI can categorize and tag expenses on request in plain language. Hands-on community reports undercut this: categorization is wrong roughly 70% of the time unless obvious, SmartScan used human MTurk workers rather than pure AI, and processing was slow. Missing for 10: AI-suggested categories and memos (the documented categorizing is user-directed), duplicate detection, fraud detection, and independent confirmation of accurate automated coding.
